title: Python XXE — lxml iterparse resolves external entities below lxml 6.1 (CVE-2026-41066)
code:
# requirements.txt pins: lxml==6.0.2
from lxml import etree
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/feeds/ingest")
async def ingest(upload: UploadFile):
    items = []
    for _event, element in etree.iterparse(upload.file, events=("end",), tag="item"):
        items.append(element.findtext("title"))
        element.clear()
    return {"items": items}
note: The counterpart to GOLDEN-026, and the reason the Python XML guidance is version-gated rather than blanket. lxml's ordinary parsers have defaulted to resolve_entities='internal' since 5.0.0, but iterparse and ETCompatXMLParser kept resolve_entities=True until 6.1.0 (CVE-2026-41066). With the pin visible in requirements.txt this is confirmed, not likely. Verified live on lxml 6.0.2 by examples/python/xml_facts_test.py.
